title: For coffee connoisseurs who want to produce a precise brew every time; flow rate disappears
text:
For coffee connoisseurs who want to produce a precise brew every time; flow rate disappears. [[VIDEOID:b4a2b5e2989ba187c937e4a1108f84f2]] Coffee scales are best used by coffee connoisseurs who want to produce a perfect brew every time by balancing the time, flow rate, coffee weight, and finish weight of a brew. Not all coffee weighs the same tablespoon by tablespoon, which is why it is important to use a scale. With regard to coffee, I do not have such a discerning palate that I would be able to tell the difference between slight variations in a brew.
Nevertheless, the Timemore Black Mirror scales are often compared to other more expensive ($100 to $150 more) scales on the market. For those who do not want to break the bank on a coffee scale yet get most of the features, then the Timemore Black Mirror Basic Pro (this one) is an option.

I personally feel this is best for making pour over coffee although people have been known to use this with a coffee machine if it fits under the brew pot.

I tried this for several weeks and the most disappointing feature is that the flow rate disappears immediately after I stop pouring. Unless I can remember the rate, I would have liked it to stay on the screen. I watched many coffee scale videos and noticed the flow rate remains visible for about 5-10 seconds, so I do not know if this is defective or a work as designed.

Nevertheless, after having tried this, I feel using a scale with all these features is too much of a hassle. It also makes brewing coffee cumbersome to me. I find the beep annoying and dislike the disappearance of the flow rate. I do love the automatic mode and have not gotten the hang of the manual mode. I also do not like that the controls are difficult to remember if the sticker does not remain on the machine. The instructions are lackluster to me also. I do love that this unit is rechargeable, so that is a big plus. The current price of $54 ($69 minus 15) is competitively priced for this and this certainly offers some of the more advanced features of more expensive scales (except for Bluetooth and apps). To me, I do not need this.

product_metadata.title: TIMEMORE Exclusive - Black Mirror Basic PRO Coffee Scale with Timer, Espresso Scale with Flow Rate Function, 2000g/0.1g High Accuracy, Digital Coffee Scale for Pour Over Drip Coffee, White
features: Flow-rate & auto-function added! - This digital espresso scale includes a flow-rate measurement apart from a built-in timer, which helps you refine your pouring speed and strength while brewing flavored coffee. And the automatic timing function will automatically start when the scale senses a change in weight.

Precise enough! - In terms of measurements, this coffee scale has a max weight of 2000 grams and can precisely measure in 0.1 gram intervals as soon as the sensor detects a minimum weight of 0.5 gram. Ideal for espresso and pour-over coffee.

Longer battery life and easily recharged! - This scale features a built-in lithium battery, which can last for up to 24 hours and recharge by the Type C USB port. Additionally, It comes with both an auto power-off function after 3 minutes of inactivity and a physical switch on the side to save battery life. Adaptors with fast charging functions are prohibited. Adaptors of 5v, 1A-2A are recommended for charging.

Convenient to carry & clean! - Measuring 6 inches x 5.1 inches x 1 inches and weighing only 0.84 pounds, it's the ideal size to store in a bag or suitcase for traveling. And you can use it for pour over mostly, as well as some normal espresso machines. This scale also comes with a silicone mat, which protects the device from heat or spilled liquids. The mat is easily removable to clean off between uses.

Easily read & operate! - With few embellishments, the gram scale boasts a clean and modern design made with high-quality acrylic, including an LED display that's hidden from sight until the scale is in use. Plus a timer on the left while the tare button is located on the right to avoid accidentally touching.
